vulnerability_name: WebKit Memory Corruption & Remote Code Execution
short_description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can execute arbitrary code or bypass security boundaries via maliciously crafted web requests.
An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit broken access control to create unauthorized admin accounts and execute commands.
required_action: Apply vendor patches immediately or restrict external access.

vulnerability_name: Remote Code Execution via Insecure Deserialization
short_description: Insecure deserialization allows remote unauthenticated attackers with network access to run arbitrary shell commands on the server.
A heap-based buffer overflow in the file share daemon allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted requests.
JNDI lookup features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints, allowing unauthenticated RCE.
A command injection vulnerability in web components allows authenticated admins to send crafted requests and execute arbitrary commands.
A command injection in the GlobalProtect feature enables an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.
